name: ic_C15p
comment: max of FRIB generic trace[0] over time buckets 1050-1250. Window carried over from the a2091 UKF analysis (pid/ic_15C.json), which used the same detector, channel and reduction. The IC amplitude spectrum is a Z ladder: the gated peak near 1145 ADC is Z=6, the one near 2055 is Z=8.
